build_wav2vec2_model: build a Wav2Vec2Model instance from a Wav2Vec2Config to pretrain on raw audio waveforms
extract_features_wav2vec2: extract features from raw audio using Wav2Vec2Model extract_features with optional masking disabled
quantize_wav2vec2: quantize audio features to discrete codes using Wav2Vec2Model quantize with a GumbelVectorQuantizer
remove_pretraining_modules: remove pretraining modules from Wav2Vec2Model to prepare for fine-tuning on a downstream task
build_conv_feature_extractor: build a ConvFeatureExtractionModel with configurable conv layers to extract features from raw audio
